# WD5 · Nhóm khách (vòng đời)

Group **WD · CSKH & theo dõi** · dialog · Next.js: **built (U7)** (`/crm`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#handle`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#dashboard`
- CSKH screens are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (queue, task and expected-date dialogs, protocol, activity, segments); commands live in `crm-automation.js` (`PemaCRM`).
- `handle('segment')`: dialog titled with the lifecycle stage label and one row per patient of the stage with "Mở hồ sơ" (opens the CRM tab); empty text "Chưa có khách trong nhóm."
- Inventory note: Opened from a lifecycle tile of the dashboard; the title is the stage label (5 stages).
- Page key `dashboard` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"dashboard\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"segment\"][data-id=\"treating\"]"} → {"wait":".modal-backdrop .modal"}; it must show "Đang điều trị".

## Business rules
- "Khách đặt lịch chưa được tính là đã quay lại. Chỉ ghi nhận quay lại khi check-in sau CSKH." (a booking after CSKH is not a returned patient until a check-in).

## Differences from the app design
- Canvas shows 12 sample patients (old web: 42 in the stage). The empty text "Chưa có khách trong nhóm." of an empty stage has no scripted state and no frame (inventory has one id for the dialog).

## Gotchas
- Every CSKH dialog uses `crm-modal` with its own `#crm-error` line; errors of the commands are shown there, not in a toast.
